contract.seed_policy: mean all three seeds; never select the best seed
contract.primary_selection: unweighted validation MAE in grams; no test-based decisions
selection_order: For each variant, select its lowest-validation-MAE recipe (direct, stacking, residual, fixed blend).
If best 344 MAE <= best 454 MAE + 0.5 g, select 344; otherwise select 454.
Within one variant, exact MAE ties: lower validation RMSE, fewer fitted components, then recipe name.
If the selected C recipe does not beat CNN-only validation MAE, retain CNN-only as the recommendation; report all planned comparisons.
contract.parsimony_note: User-approved practical selection tolerance, not a statistical equivalence claim.

weights.period_column: survey_date (training sampler metadata only, excluded from X)
weights.rule: legacy C-step 40:60 period weighting, recomputed on current train only
weights.upstream_A_sampler_columns: all missing; not used or filled from validation/test

contract.missingness: Preserve NaN; no interpolation, zero fill, global median, scaling or PCA refit. CatBoost nan_mode=Min.
contract.constant_policy: Drop only train-all-missing or train nunique(dropna=False)<=1. Preserve original wide/schema.
contract.residual_base_note: pred_weight_cnn is stored separately and appended only for direct_stacking. Existing permitted cnn_pred_weight_current/history features remain per frozen schema.
contract.row_policy: Preserve all 1288 rows and IDs; no performance-based filtering, deduplication or rematching of learning rows.
contract.supervised_feature_lineage: train owner OOF; validation/test held-out-bed fold ensembles; fixed label-free train PCA reused
contract.validation_role: Development set already used in A-step epoch selection; not a new independent holdout.
contract.test_policy: No C-step test prediction/metric inspection before validation selection and planned ablations are frozen. Exporting unchanged test targets is not evaluation.
contract.test_prior_exposure: A-step test results have already been seen; call it fixed held-out-bed evaluation, not a pristine external blind test.
contract.fold_note: upstream_oof_fold preserves A-step prediction provenance; it does not make a naive C-step inner CV nested/independent. Do not claim nested OOF validation.

ablation.stage: After validation full-recipe selection; validation only before test release
ablation.method: drop one group at a time, same parameters/seeds/rows/weights
ablation.selection_use: diagnostic only for this frozen run; no new adaptive feature search
ablation.blend_rule: If selected recipe is blend, remove each group from both components and preserve fixed 50:50 weights

contract.historical_comparison: Historical R2 about 0.855 used a different cohort/split. Context only; primary gain is against current A-step on the identical rows.
limitations: Upstream camera choice used full-track image-quality statistics and remains unchanged by user decision.
Retrospective held-out-bed design, not future-date or independent-crop validation.
Environment uses prior completed days; GDD starts at sensor coverage, not transplanting.
DAT and plot interpolation are display-only and excluded from learning inputs.
